description.text: Certificate Granting Students are required to complete the curriculum, fullfill the designated number of credits, complete the master thesis and defend of it. Successful graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with the degree

duration.text: The Aerospace Propulsion Theory and Engineering at Beihang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5833 USD/per year ￥ 42000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. Financial support statement A certificate from the financial guarantor of the applicant. 7. Health certificate Required during application.Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months)

requirements.text: 1. The Applicant should be expected to study hard, observe the laws and decrees of the Chinese government and abide by the regulations of BUAA. 2. He/she must have a master's degree or have the equivalent educational background of a master's degree. 3. In general, the applicant should be forty-five years of age or under. 4. He/she must pass the entrance examination organized by the university. 5. He/she must be proficient in English and able to take courses in English or in Chinese.
